create.name: Canadian Christian Meditation Community (WCCM Canada)
create.bio:
The Canadian Christian Meditation Community is the Canadian branch of the World Community for Christian Meditation, a registered charity with a national resource centre in Ontario. It has a special link with John Main, who taught in Montreal in his final years and from whose priory the worldwide community grew. It passes on his prayer of the heart: sitting still twice a day for twenty to thirty minutes and silently saying the prayer word maranatha in four even syllables, letting go of thoughts as they come.

Its life is grassroots, built on weekly groups in cities, towns and villages across the country and online groups that share Zoom links through their facilitators. A national council organises retreats, conferences and teaching weekends, publishes a quarterly newsletter and supports meditation in Christian schools. Its website offers a detailed guide to meditating, practical tips and answers on the mantra, introduction-to-meditation events, a video library and classroom timers.
